description.value: Brassneck Brewery is an independent craft brewery with a walk-in tasting room and growler shop on Vancouver's Main Street, offering a rotating tap list of eclectic styles ranging from tart barrel-aged fruit beers to an 11% Chocolate Banana Imperial Milkshake Stout. The brewery fills growlers from other breweries as well, making it a handy stop for cyclists wanting to stock up. Food is available from their sister restaurant The Magnet, including options to take home.
